entries.question: How should improvement success be judged: which metric or end state matters most?
entries.answer: Success means a human or AI can reproduce which independent reviewers judged the same case, preserve each verdict, rationale, evidence and confidence, identify exact disagreement dimensions, trace any override or adjudication without deleting originals, and route low independence, unresolved conflict, unsupported override, adjudicator conflict, insufficient data, or unverified evidence to governance. Agreement rate and majority count remain evidence, never semantic truth, quality, competence, or authority.
entries.expectation_state: runtime captured first-round clarification answers and can proceed to need validation

entries.question: need validation で何が確定したか
entries.answer: The broad continuation request is reframed into the smallest gap after v0.6.36: preserve disagreement instead of collapsing resolution evidence into one authoritative result. Extending calibration-report preserves the existing decision-to-resolution chain.

entries.question: framework self-audit で次に残る gap は何か
entries.answer: The committed reviewer judgments and adjudication are illustrative and insufficient; real independent reviewer evidence, accountable adjudicator authority, and operational feedback remain pilot work.
